name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
summary: At the Mirage Raceway, Kravel Koalbeard sends you to Ratchet for parts the gnomes are waiting on.

sections.title: Legwork for Kravel
sections.body: Kravel Koalbeard tends to the needs of the Mirage Raceway. A batch of parts reached Ratchet a week ago, and the gnomes are waiting. Since Kravel cannot make the journey himself, he asks you to carry his order. If you do, he promises more work with serious profit potential.

sections.title: The Docks of Ratchet
sections.body: Ratchet lies in the Barrens, where Kravel expects Wharfmaster Dizzywig to be at the docks. The goblin is the one you need to see. You carry Kravel's Parts Order there.

faq.q: Who sends you to Wharfmaster Dizzywig?
faq.answer: Kravel Koalbeard, a dwarf at the Mirage Raceway in Thousand Needles, gives you his parts order and sends you to Ratchet.

faq.q: Where can Wharfmaster Dizzywig be found?
faq.answer: Wharfmaster Dizzywig, a goblin, will probably be at the docks of Ratchet in the Barrens.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Kravel's order?
faq.answer: The gnomes of the Mirage Raceway are waiting for parts that reached Ratchet a week ago. Kravel cannot go himself, so he asks you to carry his order to the docks there.
The next step in the chain is Parts for Kravel.
